**Summary of findings:** Phuket is a thin tech-event market. The one standout recurring event — the [Phuket AI Marketing SEO Summit](https://phuketsummit.com/) — runs each April (next: April 22–24, 2027). For the rest of 2026, the [Global Wellness Summit](https://www.globalwellnesssummit.com/2026-global-wellness-summit/) (Nov 10–13, Angsana Laguna) is the only Phuket event with meaningful tech/innovation content. Bangkok is where Thailand's real conference calendar lives (Techsauce, Aug 27–29). The island's tech scene is primarily its active digital-nomad community anchored around coworking spaces in Rawai and Patong.
